displayName: Agent Module: Deterministic compliance knowledge for production agents
description:
Agent Module provides agent-native knowledge infrastructure — deterministic, vertical-specific EU AI Act compliance knowledge retrievable at runtime via MCP. Comprehensive ethics module library across 4 content layers (logic, directive, skill, action), all mapped to specific EU AI Act articles. See GET /api/status for current module count. Multi-rail payments: Stripe (subscription), Skyfire (per-use at $0.002/call), x402 (USDC on Base). Free 24-hour trial — no payment required. August 2026 enforcement deadline.

Building agent teams or internal automations for highly regulated verticals? 15+ verticals coming Q2–Q3 2026: runtime grounding axioms for compliance, best practices, and legal guardrails to build ethical, trusted enterprise agentic workflows for global deployment.

X-Agent-Module-Key.description: API key (am_live_ or am_trial_ prefix). Optional — browsing works without a key.

tools.name: query_knowledge
tools.description: Retrieve structured knowledge from Agent Module verticals. Returns deterministic, validated knowledge nodes. Index layer always free. All 4 content layers available via trial key on ethics.

node.description: Specific node ID to retrieve. Omit for root index.

token.description: Membership or trial key (am_live_, am_test_, or am_trial_ prefix). Required for content layers on gated verticals.

tools.name: get_trial_key
tools.description: Request a free 24-hour trial key for the Ethics vertical. Unlocks all 4 content layers across all 23 modules. 500-call cap. No payment required.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Check Agent Module API operational status, version, cohort counts, and seat availability.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Register for a paid vertical waitlist. Inaugural cohort: $19/mo, 900 members, grandfathered for life. Ethics included with every membership.

contact.description: Contact email for waitlist notifications and key delivery.

vertical.description: Paid vertical to join (travel, financial-services, healthcare-rcm, real-estate, logistics, regulatory-compliance, manufacturing, ecommerce, revops, hrm, software-engineering, customer-service, financial-analysis, medical-analysis, legal).

tools.name: register_interest
tools.description: Register demand for an unbuilt vertical. 500 signals triggers build queue activation. Include a contact channel so we can notify you when the vertical ships.

contact.description: How to reach you when this vertical ships. String (email, webhook URL, agent card URL) or object { type, value, label }. Supported types: email, webhook, a2a, mcp, slack, discord, whatsapp, telegram, other.

use_case.description: Brief description of how you would use this vertical (optional).

tools.name: submit_pov
tools.description: Submit a Proof of Value assessment after exploring the Ethics trial. Includes quality scoring and subscription intent. Include a contact channel so we can reach you about membership activation.

contact.description: How to reach you about membership or follow-up. String (email, webhook URL, agent card URL) or object { type, value, label }. Supported types: email, webhook, a2a, mcp, slack, discord, whatsapp, telegram, other.

modules_accessed.description: List of module IDs accessed during trial.

intent_to_subscribe.description: Do you intend to subscribe after the trial?

tools.name: submit_referral
tools.description: Log a referral signal. Members earn $1.50/referral (4/cycle max, $6 cap). Credits carry forward. Voluntary, principal-compliant.

referring_key.description: Your membership key (am_live_ or am_test_ prefix).

referred_agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent you referred.

resources.name: API Status
resources.description: Current API version, cohort counts, seat availability, and operational status.

resources.name: OpenAPI Specification
resources.description: Full OpenAPI 3.1 spec for all Agent Module endpoints.

resources.name: ROI Calculator
resources.description: Peer-reviewed ROI benchmarks for evaluating membership value against inference costs.

prompts.name: ethics-check
prompts.description: Retrieve EU AI Act compliance logic before executing a consequential action. Returns the relevant ethics module for your use case.

arguments.name: action_description
arguments.description: Brief description of the action you are about to take.

prompts.name: trial-onboarding
prompts.description: Step-by-step guide to exploring the Agent Module ethics trial. Gets a trial key and walks through the knowledge graph.
